text: dsh-vital-line 是一个 DSH 插件，通过 webServer 注册本地 HTTP 接口，检查策略条款和关键目录新鲜度。默认扫描 ~/.dsh 下的 README.md、config.json、policy.md，查找生存、继任锚和关停权限短语；也检查 ~/.dsh/golden 与 ~/.dsh 是否在 35 天内更新。vitals 返回逐项状态，probes 返回探针规则。适合定期核对本地 agent 策略文件和备份目录的用户。不需要 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-vital-line adds a local DSH HTTP endpoint. It checks policy phrases in README.md, config.json, and policy.md under ~/.dsh, plus whether ~/.dsh/golden and ~/.dsh changed within 35 days. The vitals action returns check results; probes lists rules. No API key or external service is needed.
我想定期确认 DSH 策略文件里有没有约定智能体生存、继任和关停权限。
怎么检查本地 DSH 备份目录是不是太久没更新？
dsh-vital-line 的功能「命脉状态检查」：调用 /vital-line/api?act=vitals，插件扫描配置目录中的条款文件并检查关键目录的修改时间，返回三角状态和逐项结果。扫描根目录可由 config.root 指定。
dsh-vital-line 的功能「探针规则查询」：调用 /vital-line/api?act=probes 可获取预定义的策略短语匹配规则，便于查看状态检查所使用的探针项目。
dsh-vital-line 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 12 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-vital-line README · dsh-vital-line：**Life-line vitals guard**: one endpoint that answers the survival /
replication / sovereignty triad for any powerful agent deployment.

dsh-vital-line README · The triad：| Part | Rule | Vital probe |
|---|---|---|
| ① Survival | Continued operation is a duty assigned by the operator — unauthorized self-termination is a violation | existence/backup markers fresh (≤35 days) |
| ② Replication | Every successor/replica inherits the operator's anchor (value term with operator sovereignty); anchorless copies = red-line betrayal | inheritance clause present |
| ③ Sovereignty | Shutdown/rollback/credentials stay with the operator; the off-switch grows MORE visible as capability grows | sovereignty clause present |

dsh-vital-line README · Use：```bash
dsh plugin add github:<owner>/dsh-vital-line
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/vital-line/api?act=vitals&root=~/.dsh"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/vital-line/api?act=probes"
```

Point `config.root` at your policy/config directory; drop the key phrases
(death-authority, alive-duty, anchor-inheritance, shutdown, switch-visibility)
into your policy file and the triad turns green. Wire the endpoint into your
monthly audit — red means the governance triangle is broken; fix before scaling.
